children: Spain's current account surplus narrowed to EUR 2.41 billion in June 2026 from EUR 5.33 billion in the same month last year.
The goods and services surplus fell to EUR 3.28 billion from EUR 6.17 billion.
Meanwhile, tourism revenues widened to EUR 10.45 billion from EUR 10.08 billion.
The primary and secondary income deficit widened to EUR 0.86 billion from EUR 0.84 billion.

title: Spain Current Account Surplus Narrows in June
